items.finding: Confirmed delayed all-away trigger, guest fail-closed stop, alarm/access/load actions, presence-lighting resume, and linked completion notification.
Confirmed delayed return-home trigger, home alarm mode, and towel-rack restoration.
State inventory entry exists, but the automation config endpoint did not resolve it; guide claims remain limited to visible eligibility and reset behavior.
Confirmed room presence integration state is translated into paired enabled/disabled display helpers.
Confirmed camera review start/end events set and clear a deck occupancy helper only for relevant person evidence.
Confirmed configured contact changes send replacing open/closed notifications linked to the relevant app route.
Confirmed available temperature sources produce whole-home, room, and sensor range/color display helpers.
Confirmed guest sleep/presence state changes direct room tracking while global guest critical protection remains separately synchronized.
Confirmed robot mode values are translated into stable household display text after changes and startup.
Confirmed a staged front-entry coordinator correlates recent evidence and keeps detailed evidence out of short household notification copy.
Confirmed the script is intentionally inert and immediately stops, supporting explicit internal classification.
Confirmed one validated room key increments one durable ranking counter and unsupported values stop without device changes.
Confirmed debounced notification recall after live overdue, today, and locally expired counts all clear.
Confirmed twice-daily per-person summaries, Vacation suppression, local-date expiry, live-tab deep links, and replacing notification tags.
Confirmed manual alarm mode changes notify while the presence-owned Away transition avoids a duplicate status push.
Confirmed stable-close waiting, reopen restart behavior, guest blocking, in-progress state, lock command, and completion notification.
Confirmed recent deck evidence and recognized people are correlated into logbook summaries while camera blueprints retain media-push ownership.
Confirmed evening or overnight door and camera demand snapshots the current look and forces bright cool-white walkway visibility.
Confirmed the manual recovery stages coupling, relay unlock, power-on, relock, and return to decoupled operation.
Confirmed a nightly cleanup deregisters only stale unavailable browser sessions.
Confirmed inventory mutation events collapse into one delayed refresh and clear-only critical cleanup without new per-item pushes.
Confirmed the room toggle changes bathroom lighting, relay behavior, thermostat tracking, presence display state, vacuum exclusion, and shared vacuum guard sync.
Confirmed automatic end, invalid-range fail-off, recoverable intent, startup reconciliation, and no reactivation after an expired corrected end.
Confirmed a one-shot bedtime preparation scene changes selected lights and clears its request helper.
Confirmed user-visible wake days are translated to prior sleep-session schedule days and published to one bed side.
Confirmed friendly receiver source choices map to equipment inputs only while the Theater media source is on.
Confirmed state-dependent wake and shutdown branches, confirmation waits, timeout labels, and helper reconciliation.
Confirmed a backend battery-range update refreshes only the formatted household charge label.
Confirmed recovered dock components or stable docking clear matching room-scoped maintenance tasks and resolved transient dock errors.
